description: Open, close, or read the preview pane beside the chat. open: show a web URL (bare domains fine), a localhost dev server, or a file path (HTML renders live) — opens for the current window only. close: dismiss the whole pane, or one tab via url. read: what the pane currently shows — returns {kind, url, title, text, start, end, total_chars}; a Browser tab's text is the rendered page's visible text, paged with start/count (char offsets); a file tab answers identity only (read the file with read_file).
name: desktop_preview

count.description: read: chars to return (capped per read).

url.description: open: the target. close: one tab (omit for the whole pane).
